name: The Good News According to Luke

verses.text: When he went into the house of one of the rulers of the Pharisees on a Sabbath to eat bread, they were watching him.
Behold, a certain man who had dropsy was in front of him.
Jesus, answering, spoke to the lawyers and Pharisees, saying, “\+w Is \+w it \+w lawful \+w to \+w heal \+w on \+w the \+w Sabbath
But they were silent. He took him, and healed him, and let him go.

He answered them, “\+w Which \+w of \+w you \+w if \+w your \+w son \+w or \+w an \+w ox \+w fell \+w into \+w a \+w well wouldn’\+w t \+w immediately pull \+w him \+w out \+w on \+w a \+w Sabbath \+w day
They couldn’t answer him regarding these things.
He spoke a parable to those who were invited, when he noticed how they chose the best seats, and said to them,

“\+w When \+w you \+w are \+w invited \+w by \+w anyone \+w to \+w a \+w wedding \+w feast don’\+w t \+w sit \+w in \+w the best seat, \+w since \+w perhaps \+w someone \+w more honorable \+w than \+w you \+w might \+w be \+w invited \+w by \+w him *

\+w and \+w he \+w who \+w invited \+w both \+w of \+w you \+w would \+w come \+w and \+w tell \+w you ‘\+w Make \+w room \+w for \+w this \+w person \+w Then \+w you \+w would begin, \+w with shame, \+w to \+w take \+w the lowest \+w place *

\+w But \+w when \+w you \+w are \+w invited \+w go \+w and \+w sit \+w in \+w the lowest \+w place \+w so \+w that \+w when \+w he \+w who \+w invited \+w you \+w comes \+w he \+w may \+w tell \+w you ‘\+w Friend \+w move \+w up higher.’ \+w Then \+w you \+w will \+w be \+w honored \+w in \+w the \+w presence \+w of \+w all \+w who \+w sit \+w at \+w the \+w table \+w with \+w you *
\+w For \+w everyone \+w who \+w exalts \+w himself \+w will \+w be \+w humbled \+w and \+w whoever \+w humbles \+w himself \+w will \+w be \+w exalted

He also said to the one who had invited him, “\+w When \+w you \+w make \+w a \+w dinner \+w or \+w a \+w supper don’\+w t \+w call \+w your \+w friends \+w nor \+w your brothers, \+w nor \+w your \+w kinsmen \+w nor \+w rich \+w neighbors \+w or \+w perhaps \+w they \+w might \+w also return \+w the favor, \+w and pay \+w you back. *
But \+w when \+w you \+w make \+w a \+w feast ask \+w the \+w poor \+w the maimed, \+w the \+w lame or \+w the \+w blind *

\+w and \+w you \+w will \+w be \+w blessed \+w because \+w they don’\+w t \+w have \+w the resources \+w to \+w repay \+w you \+w For \+w you \+w will \+w be repaid \+w in \+w the resurrection \+w of \+w the \+w righteous *
When one of those who sat at the table with him heard these things, he said to him, “Blessed is he who will feast in God’s Kingdom!”
But he said to him, “\+w A \+w certain \+w man \+w made \+w a \+w great \+w supper \+w and \+w he \+w invited \+w many \+w people *
\+w He \+w sent \+w out \+w his \+w servant \+w at \+w supper \+w time \+w to \+w tell \+w those \+w who \+w were \+w invited ‘\+w Come \+w for everything \+w is \+w ready \+w now *

\+w They \+w all \+w as \+w one \+w began \+w to \+w make \+w excuses “\+w The \+w first \+w said \+w to \+w him ‘\+w I \+w have bought \+w a field, \+w and \+w I \+w must \+w go \+w and \+w see \+w it \+w Please \+w have \+w me \+w excused
“\+w Another \+w said ‘\+w I \+w have bought \+w five \+w yoke \+w of \+w oxen \+w and \+w I \+w must \+w go \+w try \+w them \+w out \+w Please \+w have \+w me \+w excused
“\+w Another \+w said ‘\+w I \+w have \+w married \+w a \+w wife \+w and \+w therefore \+w I \+w can \+w come *

“\+w That \+w servant \+w came \+w and \+w told \+w his \+w lord \+w these \+w things \+w Then \+w the \+w master \+w of \+w the \+w house \+w being \+w angry \+w said \+w to \+w his \+w servant ‘\+w Go \+w out \+w quickly \+w into \+w the \+w streets \+w and \+w lanes \+w of \+w the \+w city \+w and \+w bring \+w in \+w the \+w poor maimed, \+w blind \+w and \+w lame
“\+w The \+w servant \+w said ‘\+w Lord \+w it \+w is \+w done \+w as \+w you \+w commanded \+w and \+w there \+w is \+w still \+w room

“\+w The \+w lord \+w said \+w to \+w the \+w servant ‘\+w Go \+w out \+w into \+w the \+w highways \+w and \+w hedges \+w and compel \+w them \+w to \+w come \+w in \+w that \+w my \+w house \+w may \+w be \+w filled *

\+w For \+w I \+w tell \+w you \+w that \+w none \+w of \+w those \+w men \+w who \+w were \+w invited \+w will \+w taste \+w of \+w my \+w supper \+w For many \+w are \+w called \+w but few \+w are chosen.*’”*
Now great multitudes were going with him. He turned and said to them,

“\+w If \+w anyone \+w comes \+w to \+w me \+w and doesn’\+w t disregard* \+w his \+w own \+w father \+w mother \+w wife \+w children brothers, \+w and sisters, \+w yes \+w and \+w his \+w own \+w life \+w also \+w he \+w can t \+w be \+w my \+w disciple *
\+w Whoever doesn’\+w t \+w bear \+w his \+w own \+w cross \+w and \+w come \+w after \+w me \+w can t \+w be \+w my \+w disciple *

\+w For \+w which \+w of \+w you \+w desiring \+w to \+w build \+w a \+w tower doesn’\+w t \+w first \+w sit \+w down \+w and \+w count \+w the \+w cost \+w to see \+w if \+w he \+w has enough \+w to complete \+w it *
\+w Or \+w perhaps \+w when \+w he \+w has \+w laid \+w a \+w foundation \+w and isn’\+w t \+w able \+w to \+w finish \+w everyone \+w who \+w sees begins \+w to \+w mock \+w him *
\+w saying ‘\+w This \+w man began \+w to \+w build \+w and wasn’\+w t \+w able \+w to \+w finish *

\+w Or \+w what \+w king \+w as \+w he \+w goes \+w to \+w encounter \+w another \+w king \+w in \+w war \+w will \+w not \+w sit \+w down \+w first \+w and \+w consider \+w whether \+w he \+w is \+w able \+w with \+w ten \+w thousand \+w to \+w meet \+w him \+w who \+w comes \+w against \+w him \+w with \+w twenty \+w thousand *
\+w Or \+w else \+w while \+w the \+w other \+w is \+w yet \+w a great way off, \+w he sends \+w an envoy \+w and \+w asks \+w for conditions \+w of \+w peace *
\+w So \+w therefore \+w whoever \+w of \+w you \+w who doesn’\+w t renounce \+w all \+w that \+w he \+w has \+w he \+w can t \+w be \+w my \+w disciple
“Salt \+w is \+w good \+w but \+w if \+w the salt becomes flat \+w and \+w tasteless \+w with \+w what \+w do \+w you season \+w it *

\+w It \+w is \+w fit \+w neither \+w for \+w the \+w soil \+w nor \+w for \+w the \+w manure \+w pile \+w It \+w is thrown \+w out \+w He \+w who \+w has \+w ears \+w to hear, \+w let \+w him hear.”*
